newsitem.title: UK: Tesco, British Land in retail property pact.
newsitem.headline: Tesco, British Land in retail property pact.

text.p: British supermarket group Tesco Plc and property giant British Land Co Plc said on Thursday they would form a 50-50 joint venture that will own 175 million pounds ($293.8 million) worth of retail freehold properties. The venture will be funded by 35 million pounds of equity to be provided equally by the two firms and by a 140 million pound, seven-year bank loan.
Tesco,British Land in retail property pact
The joint venture, called BLT Properties Ltd, will purchase properties from Tesco for 82 million pounds.
The properties will include three superstores, a distribution centre, and two retail parks, among other sites.
An additional, 93 million pounds worth of properties will be acquired from British Land, including five superstores leased to Tesco and a Tesco distribution centre.

"We expect to expand our involvement in this and similar ventures, where the ability to arrange finance on attractive terms also frees up the corporate balance sheet for further initiatives," British Land said.
For its part, Tesco said it viewed the venture as a way to obtain funding for the properties while keeping a stake in them.
"Tesco will also re-acquire an interest in the freeholds of a range of properties from which it operates," Tesco said in the companies' joint statement.
